description: Get a complete design system for building an app with branding like a specific company. Say 'Make me an app with branding like Spotify' and get the full token set, style guide, and implementation instructions. Matches against 12 known design systems and provides closest match with ready-to-use CSS.

company.description: The company whose branding to use (e.g. 'Spotify', 'Stripe', 'Apple', 'Linear', 'Airbnb')

format.description: Output format: 'css' for CSS variables, 'dtcg' for W3C tokens, 'guide' for full implementation guide. Default: guide

mode.description: Color mode preference. Default: based on the system's primary mode

name: get_brand_system
